fusion: Preserve 448+672 aligned equal-weight concatenation and one common reference patch
metric: Automatic OAS shrinkage covariance fitted only on the assigned reference bank; full-rank centered whitening divided by sqrt(768); no L2 renormalization after whitening; exact squared distance / 2
unchanged: Original reference rotation/background handling, fine-scale PCA mask, top-1-percent score, original-resolution sigma-4 map rendering
calibration: Original 20 held-out normal images only for the 95th-percentile threshold; excluded from metric fitting and bank; restore NumPy RNG after calibration
evaluation: Image and exact original-resolution pixel AUROC including normal tests; category macro per seed then mean/population SD. Report image/pixel tradeoff and all categories.
selection: User selected OAS after exploratory ablations on the same test set; not independent confirmation. No parameter grid or extra normal training images.
measured_source: 19de944, original orthogonal-module runner; this PR extracts the numerically identical OAS-only path without rerunning the matrix
